title: Oil up on Middle East fighting while AI bulls carry stocks higher

summary: By Tom Westbrook SINGAPORE, June 3 (Reuters) - Oil prices rose for a third day running on Wednesday and the dollar was on the brink of breaking the 160 yen barrier as fresh hostilities flared in the
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 6 月 3 日 - 油价周三连续第三天上涨，美元兑日元濒临突破 160 日元大关，因为新加坡爆发了新的敌对行动。

title: Morning Bid: Marvell, a fitting name for the latest AI darling
title_zh: 早盘竞价：Marvell，最新人工智能宠儿的合适名字
summary: A look at the day ahead in European and global markets from Tom Westbrook Notwithstanding fresh hostilities in the Middle East, AI shares drove equity markets in Asia to new records on Wednesday.

title: SpaceX Seeks $135 a Share for $75 Billion IPO, Reuters Says
title_zh: 路透社称，SpaceX 寻求以每股 135 美元的价格进行 750 亿美元的 IPO
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX aims to sell 555.6 million shares ​at $135 apiece for its record-breaking $75 ​billion ⁠initial public ​offering, Reuters reported, citing an unidentified person familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据路透社援引一位不愿透露姓名的知情人士的话报道，SpaceX 计划以每股 135 美元的价格出售 5.556 亿股股票，以创纪录的 750 亿美元首次公开募股。

title: Wall St ends modestly higher as AI zeal offset by Middle East jitters

title: Trump signs executive order scaling back AI review requirements
title_zh: 特朗普签署行政命令缩减人工智能审查要求
summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley comes on Market Domination to break down the day’s leading and trending tech stories, including President Trump's executive order to scale back review requirements for AI model developers when they submit them to the federal government for ...
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 在《市场统治》节目中剖析了当天的领先和趋势科技故事，其中包括特朗普总统的行政命令，该命令减少了对人工智能模型开发人员向联邦政府提交人工智能模型开发人员的审查要求。

title: 'Nobody wants to be left behind' in AI adoption: HPE CEO on Q2 earnings
title_zh: HPE 首席执行官谈第二季度收益：在人工智能采用方面“没有人想被抛在后面”
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is holding onto major gains ahead of Tuesday's close after topping fiscal second quarter estimates for adjusted earnings ($0.79 per share vs. forecasts of $0.54) and revenue ($10.68 billion vs. forecasts of $9.74 billion).
summary_zh: 惠普企业 (HPE) 在第二财季调整后收益（每股 0.79 美元，预期为 0.54 美元）和营收（106.8 亿美元，预期为 97.4 亿美元）均超出预期后，在周二收盘前保持了大幅上涨。
